===Pokémon Dream Radar===
Professor Burnet conducts research on the Pokémon found in the Interdream Zone, and develops extensions and upgrades to the player's Beam and Vivoscope by harvesting [[Dream Cloud|Dream Orb]]s. These upgrades are used to catch the [[forces of nature]] in their [[List of Pokémon with form differences#Forces of Nature|Therian Forme]]s.
